evaluate_all_tasks: evaluate all detection tasks including boxes, masks, keypoints, and body UV for a dataset
evaluate_boxes: evaluate bounding box detection results for a dataset using COCO, Cityscapes, or VOC metrics
evaluate_masks: evaluate instance segmentation mask results for a dataset using COCO or Cityscapes metrics
evaluate_keypoints: evaluate human keypoint detection results for 2D pose estimation on a COCO dataset
evaluate_body_uv: evaluate dense pose body UV estimation results for a dataset using COCO metrics
evaluate_box_proposals: evaluate bounding box object proposals and compute recall metrics at 100 and 1000 limits
log_box_proposal_results: log bounding box proposal results with formatted recall metrics for each dataset
log_copy_paste_friendly_results: log evaluation results in a comma-separated format easy to copy into a spreadsheet
check_expected_results: check actual evaluation results against expected results and email on failure if configured
coco_eval_to_box_results: convert a COCO evaluation stats array into a formatted box detection results dictionary
